Bottlerocket supports in-place image updates; set commits/applies; removed unsupported commit/wildcard lock and unchecked drain/delete; qualified SELinux/dm-verity/rollback.

Both Config logging rule names are valid with different triggers/parameters; explicit-encryptionConfig finding is not proof of plaintext API data.
Separated GuardDuty audit/runtime coverage and SecurityHubCSPM/OCSF schemas; removed compliance and automatic protection guarantees.
Falco0.44.1 parser found missing container-plugin dependency and deprecated evt.dir; corrected rule passes with container0.7.1, negative control fails. Chart9.1.0 rendered; no live capture.
Current EKS support verified from AWS, not upstream Kubernetes release. Financial architecture is a logical example, not verified production/compliance evidence.
